title: A future-dated HR start or end reached its date (OP-156 m.3 (q))
description: The member of the SET `events` claim, and of the CloudEvent `data.events`, under `urn:suiss:access:event:hr.record_due`. At a start the account is activated and a passkey setup invitation goes out; at an end it is suspended and its sign-ins end. A notification, never an authority source (INV-24).

source.description: The HR source's name in the realm.

access_position.description: The event's monotone version field (OP-22): it only grows within its source, the domain for an authority event and the issuer for an identity event. A receiver that has applied a later or equal position re-queries instead of applying this event.
